name: account.settings
title: Account Settings
description: The declaration to configure account settings.

payloadkeys.title: Exchange
payloadkeys.content: If present, configures settings for Exchange accounts.

subkeys.title: Allow EWS Retirement Alerts
subkeys.content: If `false`, the system doesn't alert the user that an Exchange account has lost, or is about to lose, access because Microsoft is ending support for Exchange Web Services. Only applies to Exchange accounts installed by an organization.
